The requirement is to: Acquire 25 new Phantom systems manufactured by Psychology Software Tools, which may include storage and shipping when delivery is required. Engineering services to provide inspection, calibration, maintenance, Geometric Disk upgrades, and other upgrades to 105 currently installed Phantoms and up to 25 additional systems. The new Phantoms shall meet/exceed the specifications below and be 100% compatible with Phantom systems currently in-use at the VA facility. Website Development Services for the continuation of a project website already prototyped in collaboration with Psychology Software Tools. The systems will be used on an ongoing VA research study on Traumatic Brain Injuries (TBI). A Phantom is a precisely manufactured object of known size and composition that is imaged to test, adjust, or monitor; a Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) system’s homogeneity, quantitative precision, and shape geometry for the purpose of quantification and correction of both measurement accuracy and quality. Phantoms attach to M

ers to collect and calibrate diagnostics for brain imaging. The VA research office currently uses phantoms supplied by Psychology Software Tools and must continue to use the same phantoms to maintain the integrity of research results. Too many variables from other systems can skew research data and some include proprietary magnets which are not compatible with the current system. The Phantom systems require calibration to the necessary proprietary format and require anisotropic diffusion, which is critical to diffusion imaging required by VA research. a. Acquisition of Geometric Distortion Disks for 100 Existing Phantom Devices.
